Two island groups, two very different holidays

Andaman is easy to string together by ferry. Lakshadweep is slower, smaller and needs a permit. We plan both.

Andaman Islands

Port Blair, Havelock (Swaraj Dweep), Neil (Shaheed Dweep) and Baratang. Beaches, diving, and the old Ross Island ruins.

Ask about Andaman

Lakshadweep

Agatti, Bangaram, Kadmat and Kavaratti. Lagoons, snorkelling and quiet, with entry permits arranged for you.

Ask about Lakshadweep

How it works

You send dates. We send a plan you can read in one sitting.

Tell us what you want

Dates, who is travelling, and whether you prefer beaches, diving or doing very little.

We build the route

Ferry and flight timings, island order, stays and permits, checked against each other.

You travel, we stay reachable

A single contact number for the whole trip if a ferry shifts or weather changes plans.

Tell us where you want to go

We reply with a route and a price, usually within a day.
